<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def birdpos(f):
    cs=[]; rs=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs+=[p[0] for p in b]; cs+=[p[1] for p in b]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)) if cs else None
def bsum(f): return sum(1 for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
for i in range(4):
    action(['LEFT'])
    print("after LEFT",i+1,":",birdpos(current_frame),"N",bsum(current_frame),"step",current_frame.step)
    if bsum(current_frame)>0: break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
